name: FY Sales
expression: VAR Y=IF(ISINSCOPE('Financials'[Financial Year]),MAX('Financials'[Financial Year]),[Review Financial Year]) RETURN CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Sales]),'Financials'[Financial Year]=Y)
description: Selected Review Year for cards; financial-year axis for trend charts. Default FY2023-2024.
